fastQuotes.name: aio-screener-data-plane
fastQuotes.consumerGate: public-config.json marketData.fastQuotes.enabled is derived from this flag plus the measured soak and the live coverage probe (scripts/ci-fast-plane-consumer-gate.mjs)

routes.notes: quote heartbeat, revision, sourceSha, coverage and schedulerDispatch (refresh + screener receipts; token presence only)
publishes quotes on demand; the cron trigger is the normal writer
readiness metadata only; workersAiBound is a presence boolean

routes.access: X-AIO-Operator-Token (AIO_OPERATOR_TOKEN); anonymous callers get 404 for every method; no CORS; no-store
X-AIO-Automation-Token (AIO_AUTOMATION_TOKEN); anonymous callers get 404 for every method; no CORS; no-store
routes.errors: short codes only (titles-invalid 400, body-too-large 413, workers-ai-unbound / workers-ai-unparsed:* / workers-ai-failed 503); never model output
routes.budget: Workers AI account allowance, not the shared OpenAI ledger

routes.access: allowed Origin (+ AIO_APP_TOKEN when set) or origin-less X-AIO-Automation-Token

routes.notes: retired tombstone (also any path with ?anthropic=1); never calls a provider
generic CORS proxy for ALLOWED_DOMAINS only; private hosts and redirects off the allowlist refused; 5 MB / 10 s bounds

relay.name: aio-proxy
relay.boundary: upstream-host-is-hardcoded; client never supplies a destination or a key; BOK/KOSIS use operator secrets; the personal-key FRED relay was retired in v57.79 (provider=fred is unknown, 400)

security.proxyOptionalNotes: AI is the Workers AI binding ([ai] in wrangler.proxy.toml; deploy drops it only on a Workers AI permission error); AI_KILL_SWITCH='1' disables /openai; AI_CLIENT_KEY_SALT separates the per-client HMAC from OPENAI_API_KEY; WORKERS_AI_TRANSLATE_MODEL overrides the translation model

proxyQuotaContract.operatorUsage: GET /_ops/ai-usage; separate AIO_OPERATOR_TOKEN; no CORS; no-store; never add counts or AI cap to public /health
proxyQuotaContract.budgetScope: browser chat, translation and Actions analysis and conditional cited web search share one UTC-month $20 reservation ledger (owner 2026-10-11)
proxyQuotaContract.automationAuthentication: origin-less POST /openai requires X-AIO-Automation-Token; not a public browser credential
proxyQuotaContract.idempotency: X-AIO-Idempotency-Key (or X-AIO-Request-Id) matching [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,160}; otherwise a random UUID per attempt, so identical bodies are separate billable attempts (SHA-256 of time+random only when randomUUID is missing)
proxyQuotaContract.developmentOrigins: explicit exact http://localhost:<port> or http://127.0.0.1:<port> values in AIO_DEV_ORIGINS
